j4q.models

Class Mesh

  • java.lang.Object
    • j4q.models.Component
      • j4q.models.Mesh

  • public class Mesh
extends Component
    Represents a 3D mesh for rendering and geometry management.

    Handles vertex buffers, triangles, normals, UVs, tangents, and OpenGL VAO/VBO setup.
